data.title: Contract freeze: a journal from every 0.x folds to the same state
data.description: G3. The category churns on upgrades that lose data (beads #2573, the top issue in that repository; discovery 2026-09-30). 1.0 promises the format: a fixture journal per minor version 0.1-0.8, written with the event types that version produced, folded by the current code into a committed expected state. A release that folds an old fixture differently fails CI.
